name: DRAM 5800
title: Studies in Movement for the Actor
description: Topics and skills not normally included in DRAM 5801-5807. Content may include (but is not limited to) stage violence, armed or unarmed combat, gymnastics, and T'ai Chi.  May be repeated with changes in topic. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
